question: In ____________, government of India set up a committee to review the fiscal reforms and suggest appropriate framework under the chairmanship of Vijay Kelkar.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fri Mar 01 2002 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **Government of India** set up a committee to review fiscal reforms and suggest an appropriate framework under the chairmanship of **Vijay Kelkar** on **1st March 2002**. 
• The objective of the committee was to assess India's fiscal policies and propose recommendations for fiscal consolidation and reforms in **direct and indirect taxation systems**. 
• It was known as the **Kelkar Committee**, which played a pivotal role in shaping fiscal policies and reforming the tax structure in India. 
• The committee’s recommendations were aimed at improving **fiscal deficit management**, enhancing transparency, and simplifying tax laws to promote economic growth. <l
